name: Albalat dels Tarongers (Spain)
description: Horizontally divided white over red, the white charged with three green orange trees fruited yellow on a green ground, the red with a yellow castle.
history: The official flag of Albalat dels Tarongers is of proportions 2:3, divided per fess, the first white or pearl grey with three orange trees vert on a terrace of the same fruited or, the second red with a yellow castle pierced and masoned black; it was approved by resolution of 21 December 2015 of the Presidency of the Generalitat and published in the DOCV. The arms had been approved by resolution of 28 May 1999.

features.role: three orange trees fruited yellow on a green terrace
fruit of the trees and castle on the red
masonry and openings of the castle
